cmsFields.title: Perspective review: where analytics should execute
cmsFields.subtitle: Should an interactive analytics table live in the browser, on a server, or in both?
cmsFields.summary: Perspective repository review of browser and server analytics, replication and indexed updates, with data-boundary trade-offs instead of speed rankings.
keyTakeaways: Execution placement is an architecture and data-access decision, not just a UI choice.
Browser-only and replicated modes send datasets to the client.
Indexed update semantics matter when modeling changing entities rather than append-only events.
